ev.q: CDC analyzed data from the Fatality Analysis Reporting System (FARS) of the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration
Of 1,451 child passengers with known restraint information who died while riding with drinking drivers, 466 (32%) were restrained at the time of the crash.
Of the 2,335 children who died in alcohol-related crashes, 1,588 (68%) were riding with drinking drivers

methods_quotes.q: When BACs were not available, they were imputed from driver and crash characteristics by using a two-stage estimation procedure
A drinking driver was defined as a driver with a measured or imputed BAC of > 0.01 g/dL.
